review: Reviewed actual Lin request, source surface-21-lin-113 entries and world-64 review. One study round/0.2 energy precedes a paid fresh route examination and at most two1-energy/0.02-mass transfers. Exact source and creator, explicitly nominated bounded receiver, reach, complete receiver clearance, swept-radius visible ground route, live amounts and both locks are enforced. Exact hundredth mass debits and persistent destination deposits commit together with source-entry provenance; no inventory, edible stock, container, free cleanup, restoration or planting certification. Repeated starts never reset material; resumed work retains allowance and paid progress. Dynamic obstacles pause before charges; performed blocked examinations retain their actual cost. Cancel/death preserve material and release locks only. Generic rendering hides zero-mass provenance and shows only committed deposits. Tests cover actual-source conservation, unchanged inventory apart from normal ageing, range, blocked routes, dynamic invalidation, repeat, serialization, locks, cancel/death and scope. Isolated fixture coordinates are not supplied to ordinary agents. Adapter checks and exact saved-prefix reconstruction are required.
